nodes.label: Video Inpainting Intro/Survey Deck
nodes.rationale: Design-notes deck (largely CJK) surveying video inpainting approaches behind the VSR tool: flow/mask methods, 3D-CNN/RNN blocks, gated convolution, region normalization, memory search+read attention, OPN, RNoT, STTN, and a LogoLoss for logo/watermark removal (TikTok use case).

nodes.label: OPN: Onion Peel Networks for Deep Video Completion (ICCV 2019)
nodes.rationale: Fills missing regions step-by-step from boundary inward with pixel-wise attention over encoder query/key/value features; a key predecessor discussed in the deck and in the STTN paper's related work.

nodes.label: Region Normalization (RNoT)
nodes.rationale: Normalization scheme applied per known/unknown region (RN-B in encoder, RN-L in decoder with Res-Blocks) improving inpainting decoders; presented in the deck as an OPN enhancement.

nodes.label: LogoLoss for Logo Removal
nodes.rationale: Loss term discussed in the deck for training inpainting to remove logos/watermarks — directly relevant to the subtitle/watermark erase use case of the VSR tool.

nodes.label: Video Inpainting
nodes.rationale: Reconstructing masked video regions spatially and temporally coherently (vs per-frame image inpainting); the core technique that makes 'erase burned-in subtitles and recover the true background' possible in both ProPainter and STTN/VSR paths.
